title: Drift Wood #31 · the Grunion Run, early
logline: The fish are early this year. Wood is ready with contempt and a full pad.

panels.composition: The beach at night, lanterns, a smaller crowd — the run came early and half the town didn't hear. GULLY with two buckets. CHLOE with a thermos. WOOD with the pad already open.

balloons.text: They're early. Tide's wrong. They came anyway.
Nature's indifference to the festival committee.

image.prompt: a night beach with a small crowd of lantern-carrying townspeople at the surf line, three teenagers in the foreground with buckets, a thermos and an open drawing pad, black and white

panels.composition: Chloe, pouring cocoa into the thermos lid for Wood without asking.

characters.pose: taking it, not looking up from the pad

balloons.text: You said you'd never come back to this.
I came to document. It's different.

image.prompt: a teenage girl pouring cocoa from a thermos into its lid and handing it to a boy who keeps drawing, lanterns behind

panels.composition: Chloe, looking at his pad: last year's grunion drawing, redrawn from memory, better. And under it, already, tonight's.
props: the pad with two grunion drawings

balloons.text: You drew it before we got here.
I drew last year's. Tonight's is a revision.

image.prompt: close-up over a girl's shoulder of a drawing pad with two versions of a night surf scene full of small silver fish, one above the other

panels.composition: Silent. The surf. The fish. Fewer hands this year, more fish. Wood not drawing — looking. The pad closed on his knee.

characters.pose: sitting on the sand, pad closed, looking

image.prompt: silent wide night panel of a surf line flashing with hundreds of small silver fish under lantern light, a teenage boy sitting on the sand with a closed pad on his knee just watching, a girl beside him, black and white
image.notes: The pad is closed. Second time the strip notes it.
